rules.statement: Under the Roman-Dutch Law, a sale of property during litigation is interdicted after litis contestatio has given it the character of res litigiosa.
rules.supporting_quote: "It would seem that the Roman-Dutch jurists considered that litis contestatio occurs in different forms of action at different periods, but at the Cape it has been held to occur on the closing of the pleadings by Villiers C.J. (Nathan, ubi supra)."
